title: Legacy Red
description: This is a simple texture in Programmer Art style that adds multiple highlighting/utility features to improve players' survival/redstone experience.
body:
**LegacyRed** is a texture which focused on people who wants redstone display features 
but prefer the old _Minecraft_ texture(aka _Programmer Art_).   

It implements multiple highlight/utility features and 
supplies more _Programmer Art_ style icons which didn't come with the original pack.

## Features
Note: features listed below may not represent all features included in this pack and is for reference only. 
### Redstone 
* Redstone signal strength display
* Direction indicators for piston, dispenser, dropper, hopper, etc.
* Status indicator for button, lever, pressure plate, etc.
* Tripwire status display
* Noteblock instrument & tone display
* Daylight detector mode/signal strength display
* Sculk sensor direction & signal strength display

### Highlights
* Ores
* Powder snow
* Budding amethyst
* Sculk shriker/catalyst
* Trapped chests
* Suspicious sand/gravel
* Wet sponge

### Utilities
* Fluids flow direction indicate
* Enchanting table text translations
* Pumpkin head overlay removal
* Lower fire
* Bow charge progress display
* Hotbar number 0-9
* Better HP bar under wither effect

### Mod features
* Zombie pigman model replacement(requires [EntityModelFeature](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) or OptiFine)
* Mojang logo replacement(requires [Puzzle](https://modrinth.com/mod/puzzle))

### Other
* 3d-ify some items
* More _Programmer Art_ style items(e.g. Spears, Copper, etc.)
* And some Easter eggs...

## Versions
This texture pack is made for **Minecraft 1.14+**. Older versions will not be supported.
